subject: Publicity & logo use — exceptions and approval process
messages:
From: Jenna Moss <jenna.moss@novasecure.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Halvorsen <tom.halvorsen@novasecure.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Publicity / logo use in MSA/order form — request

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this. We're finalizing the order form and want to confirm publicity and logo usage scope before legal signs off. High-level asks from our side:

- One coordinated press release once we go live (co-authored).
- Permission to display the Novasecure logo on our customer page and in our partner carousel.
- A short customer quote (one sentence) for the press release and case study.

We can agree to approval rights on wording and a short review window, but we also need a limited carveout so our product performance numbers (benchmarks in the draft) can be published by our marketing team.

Attached: Novasecure_OrderForm_v2.docx and Nova_logo_guidelines.pdf.

Point of contact on our side: Tom Halvorsen (cc). If redlines are easier, could your legal team share a mark-up and we can iterate?

Appreciate it — Jenna

--
Jenna Moss
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Novasecure

Subject: Re: Publicity / logo use in MSA/order form — request

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear summary and attachments.

Quick response from a process perspective so expectations are aligned:

- Legal (cc Marissa) will propose narrow language for publicity, logo use, and quote approvals. Typical asks we push for: 5-business-day approval window, marketing asset usage limited to marketing materials and customer pages, and pre-approval of the exact quote.
- For any performance/benchmark disclosures we will need explicit carveouts in confidentiality that permit publishing agreed metrics; Marissa will advise exact wording.
- We'll ask for high-res logo files and logo usage guidelines (you included those — thank you). Please confirm whether the homepage use is required or if partner carousel + customer page is sufficient.
- I'll assemble a short mutual action plan so we have owners and deadlines (legal redline, marketing asset delivery, final signature).

Can Marissa and Karthik confirm if 5 business days for approval and a limited quote OK on your side; Marissa — can you produce a redline by end of day tomorrow?

Thanks — Irene

Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Publicity / logo use in MSA/order form — redline summary

Irene / team / Jenna —

Thanks, I've reviewed the draft order form and pulled together a concise set of recommended changes. Attached is a one-page redline_summary.pdf that highlights the key publicity/confidentiality updates. Highlights below:

1) Approval window: 5 business days for any press release or quote; silence is not approval — explicit emailed sign-off is required.
2) Quiet period: add a 30-day quiet period after signature during which neither party will issue a public announcement without mutual consent (we can make this shorter if necessary, start negotiation point).
3) Logo scope: permit logo display on "marketing materials, customer pages, and partner carousel"; homepage placement is an exception and needs a separate written approval.
4) Quote and case study: require customer review/approval of any verbatim quote. If Novasecure wants us to use their product metrics, include a narrow confidentiality carveout that specifies which metrics and a jointly agreed disclosure format.
5) Evidence: request SOC 2 (latest report) and any required security attestations before greenlighting a public quote referencing security or compliance.
6) Indemnity: standard mutual publicity indemnities (no libel/fraud claims etc.).

I can convert these bullets into tracked redlines in the order form if you'd like. Also attaching the summary for your marketing team to confirm that our usage language matches the logo_guidelines.

Irene — if you want this in a formal mutual action plan, I can create an initial timeline: Legal redline (today), marketing assets (by EOD Wed), final edits and signature (target Fri).

- Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Jenna Moss <jenna.moss@novasecure.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Halvorsen <tom.halvorsen@novasecure.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Publicity / logo use in MSA/order form — redline summary

Marissa / Irene —

Thanks for the quick turn. Overall that looks good to us. A couple notes from our side:

- The 5-business-day review window is fine.
- We can accept the quiet period for the initial launch, but request an exception to allow logo placement on our homepage (we use it in the partner strip there). If possible, we'd like a process where we provide 30 days notice and the homepage placement is considered unless Redwood objects in writing within that period.
- We'll provide a single approved quote and high-res SVG/PNG assets by Wednesday EOD.
- SOC2 report: we'll share a redacted SOC2 and a short attestation from our security team.

Tom (cc) will coordinate asset delivery. If Marissa can send the tracked changes, we'll review and return any narrow edits immediately.

Appreciate the collaboration — Jenna

Jenna / Tom / Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the fast back-and-forth. To keep momentum, here's a short agreed plan and owners: 

1) Marissa: produce tracked changes to the order form incorporating the publicity/confidentiality bullets and quiet-period language. Deliverable: "orderform_redline_v3.docx" by EOD Wed (target).
2) Novasecure (Tom): deliver high-res logo assets (SVG/PNG), approved one-sentence quote, and redacted SOC2 by Wed EOD.
3) Karthik: I'll put together the mutual action plan in HubSpot and confirm the target sign date; Karthik to own the HubSpot deal update.
4) Irene: coordinate marketing approvals and confirm whether a homepage exception is acceptable under the 30-day notice workflow — we'll log this as an exception request.

If all items are delivered on the timeline above we'll aim to finalize and sign the order form by Friday. Jenna — once Marissa sends the tracked changes, please flag any narrow edits immediately so we can keep the 5-business-day review cadence.
